hero.tagline: From cables to code — IT infrastructure, software development and home automation, all at once.

paragraphs: I'm Tommaso, IT technician and developer near Milan. I started as an electrician, and a year of wiring real systems taught me to think in reliability, safety and structure. Today I co-run two companies: Easydomotica, home automation, CCTV and alarm systems since March 2024, and PC su Misura, custom PCs and IT support for homes and businesses.
In the spare time that's left: a game in UE5, a self-hosted homelab with 20+ containers, and photography.
about.skills_line: Python · JS · Java · C# · C++ · Italian (native) · English (fluent)

stats.label: As an electrician, the hands-on start

experience.desc: Custom PCs, new and refurbished, and IT support for homes and small businesses. For companies we act as the external IT department: network, servers, backup and security.
Design and installation of home automation systems, CCTV, alarm systems and smart automations. I handle all the technical side together with my co-founder.
Residential and commercial electrical systems: installation, maintenance and compliance. The practical foundation everything else is built on.
